subject: Ciências
description_pt: Produzir diferentes sons a partir da vibração de variados objetos e identificar variáveis que influem nesse fenômeno.

components.description_pt: Produzir sons vibrando uma variedade de objetos diferentes
components.description_en: Produce sounds by vibrating a variety of different objects
components.cc_component_description: Demonstrate that vibrating matter produces sound through a planned investigation

components.description_pt: Identificar variáveis que influenciam os sons produzidos por objetos vibrantes (ex: tamanho, material, tensão)
components.description_en: Identify variables that influence the sounds produced by vibrating objects (e.g., size, material, tension)
components.cc_component_description: Identify variables including mass, material type, and energy input that affect average kinetic energy of particles

components.description_pt: Identificar evidências observáveis vinculando vibração de um objeto ao som que produz
components.description_en: Identify observable evidence linking vibration of an object to the sound it produces
components.cc_component_description: Identify observable evidence linking vibration of an object to the sound it produces

components.description_pt: Comparar como alterar uma única variável afeta o som produzido por um objeto vibrante
components.description_en: Compare how changing a single variable affects the sound produced by a vibrating object
components.cc_component_description: Analyze the relationship between the frequency of vibration and the properties of the sound produced

cc_matches.description: Sound can make matter vibrate, and vibrating matter can make sound.
Plan and conduct investigations to provide evidence that vibrating materials can make sound and that sound can make materials vibrate.

Plan an investigation to determine the relationships among the energy transferred, the type of matter, the mass, and the change in the average kinetic energy of the particles as measured by the temperature of the sample.
